description: vanilla, a multi-threaded HTTP/1.1 server written in V (epoll, SO_REUSEPORT, one worker per CPU), with its explicit router http1_1.router: each route is a `match` over the request's path segments, read through a zero-copy cursor. Handlers append the raw response into a server-owned buffer and return done, suspend or close. /json is serialized per request from the dataset's fields and gzip-compressed per request with libdeflate when the client accepts gzip. async-db and fortunes park the request on vanilla's async Postgres driver (pg_async, one pipelined pool per worker, sized from DATABASE_MAX_CONN); fortunes is rendered by hand per request with HTML escaping. /delay/{ms} parks on a one-shot timerfd. /static goes through vanilla's static_assets (precompressed .br/.gz siblings, follows the disk, sendfile for 16 KiB or more). :8081 serves json-tls, static-tls and 8gbit over TLS 1.3 (Mbed TLS 4). Built with -prod -gc none, vanilla's production build: nothing is allocated per request. Tuned: hand-written JSON and HTML, libdeflate, -gc none.
